name: claude-playbook
description: Mods that go with the playbook: plugins of function hooks that run inside Claude Code.

plugins.name: cockpit
plugins.description: A band above the prompt: context, rate limits, cost, and each live subagent with its model and its calls against the builder cap.

plugins.name: gate
plugins.description: Runs the CI gate as a tool and a /gate command, its verdict read from the exit code and exit file; shows it in the status line; refuses piped gates, edits mid-gate and pushes without a green gate.
